title: Assistant Manager, SAP ABAP
description:
**SAP ABAP Development**

* Design, develop, test, debug, document, and support SAP ABAP developments.
* Develop and maintain:
	+ Reports and interfaces
	+ Enhancements and user exit
	+ BAdIs and enhancement frameworks
	+ Function modules and classes
	+ BAPIs and RFC\-enabled objects
	+ Forms including Smart Forms and Adobe Forms
	+ Workflows where applicable
	+ Conversion and migration programs
	+ Background processing programs
* Perform object\-oriented ABAP development using appropriate SAP development standards.
* Review functional specifications and translate business requirements into technical designs and technical specifications.
* Prepare technical specifications with sufficient detail for development, testing, validation, and long\-term support.

**SAP S/4HANA \& Modern Development**

* Demonstrate hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA development concepts and technologies.
* Develop and optimize:
	+ Core Data Services ( **CDS Views** )
	+ ABAP Managed Database Procedures ( **AMDP** ) where appropriate
	+ OData services
	+ APIs and web services
	+ REST/SOAP\-based integrations
* Exposure to **ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP)** is preferred.
* Exposure to **SAP BTP ABAP Environment / ABAP Cloud** is advantageous.
* Understand S/4HANA data\-model simplification and ensure legacy ABAP programs are appropriately redesigned or optimized.
* Follow **Clean Core principles** , including preference for standard functionality, released APIs, extensibility frameworks, and side\-by\-side extensions where appropriate.
* Support SAP Fiori/UI5 applications from the ABAP backend and service\-development perspective.

**Interfaces \& Integration**

* Develop and support SAP interfaces with SAP and non\-SAP applications.
* Work with integration technologies including:
	+ IDoc/ALE
	+ RFC/BAPI
	+ OData
	+ REST/SOAP APIs
	+ Proxy/web services
	+ File\-based integrations
* Collaborate with middleware/integration teams working with platforms such as SAP Integration Suite/CPI or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Implement appropriate interface monitoring, exception handling, reprocessing, logging, and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Ensure interface programs maintain appropriate transactional integrity and prevent duplicate or incomplete processing.

**Technical Quality \& Performance**

* Perform peer code reviews and ensure adherence to SAP development standards.
* Use **ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)** and other SAP code\-quality tools to identify and remediate technical issues.
* Perform performance analysis and optimization using appropriate SAP tools.
* Ensure efficient database access and avoid performance\-intensive custom development.
* Follow secure coding standards and address identified vulnerabilities.
* Develop reusable objects and frameworks where technically and commercially appropriate.
* Support remediation of custom code during SAP upgrades, releases, and S/4HANA transformations.

**Pharmaceutical / GxP / CSV Responsibilities**

* Understand working expectations within a **regulated pharmaceutical or life\-sciences environment** .
* Follow applicable IT quality, change\-management, and validation procedures for GxP\-relevant SAP functionality.
* Support preparation and review of technical documentation required for **Computerized System Validation (CSV)** .
* Maintain appropriate traceability from approved functional requirements/specifications to technical developments and test evidence.
* Ensure GxP\-relevant developments include appropriate:
	+ Auditability
	+ Data integrity controls
	+ Error handling
	+ Authorization checks
	+ Electronic record considerations
	+ Logging and traceability
* Support QA/CSV teams during validation, defect resolution, release assessment, and audit activities.
* Ensure production changes are performed through approved change\-control and transport\-management processes.
* Support regulatory or internal audits by providing technical documentation and evidence when required.
* Awareness of **GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA\+ data\-integrity principles, and applicable GxP practices** is preferred.

**Testing \& Deployment**

* Perform developer/unit testing for all custom developments.
* Prepare appropriate unit\-test documentation and technical evidence.
* Analyse and resolve defects across development and test cycles.
* Support cutover, deployment, hyper care, and post\-go\-live activities.
* Follow appropriate SAP transport\-management procedures across development, quality, validation, and production environments.

**Production Support**

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 technical support for SAP ABAP\-related incidents and problems.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot:
	+ Dumps
	+ Failed interfaces
	+ Background jobs
	+ Performance problems
	+ Workflow failures
	+ Application logs
* Participate in major\-incident resolution when SAP technical expertise is required.
* Maintain proper technical documentation for recurring issues and resolutions.

**Required Experience \& Skills**

* **8\+ years of hands\-on SAP ABAP development experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in core ABAP and object\-oriented ABAP.
* Practical experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Strong experience in enhancements, interfaces, forms, reports, conversions, and workflows.
* Experience with CDS Views, OData, APIs, and modern S/4HANA development approaches.
* Good understanding of SAP functional processes and ability to work effectively with functional consultants.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, performance\-tuning, and root\-cause\-analysis skills.
* Experience working through complete SAP implementation and/or major transformation lifecycle preferred.
* Experience working in geographically distributed or global teams.
* Candidates from either **SAP service/consulting companies or product/end\-user organizations** are acceptable, provided they demonstrate strong hands\-on technical capability.

  
* Pharmaceutical, life\-sciences, medical\-device, or other regulated\-industry experience.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementation.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori and SAP Integration Suite.
* Experience with SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or equivalent lifecycle/change\-management platforms.
* Experience working with formal SDLC, ITIL, CSV, GxP, and change\-control processes.
* Exposure to SAP security concepts and authorization checks within custom developments.
* SAP ABAP/S/4HANA/BTP\-related certification preferred.
